installation_summary:
Installed the Klimadashboard Münster Next.js app in the shared workspace at /workspace (a plain Linux container; no venv — it runs directly on Node).

Steps performed:
1. Prerequisites: Node.js was absent. Installed Node v20.18.1 from the official nodejs.org tarball into /usr/local, and Yarn 1.22.22 via `npm i -g yarn`.
2. Documented install: `cd /workspace && yarn install --network-timeout 600000` → exit 0; 609 packages in node_modules. The project `postinstall` hooks ran and downloaded most data assets into assets/data/.
3. Recovered a partial postinstall failure: `unzip` was missing, so scripts/ms-open-data.sh and scripts/einwohner.sh failed initially. Installed `unzip` (apt-get) and re-ran ms-open-data.sh (succeeded → 25 CSVs). einwohner.sh still failed (credential reason below).
4. Documented start: `yarn dev` → Next.js 15.5.28 "Ready", serving http://localhost:3000 (left running in background, log /tmp/dev-server-final.log).

Objective results (curl): `/` → HTTP 200; `/energie` → HTTP 200; `/mobilitaet` → HTTP 500; `/gebaeude` → HTTP 500; `/klima` → HTTP 500. Dev log shows the 500s are `Module not found: Can't resolve '@/assets/data/einwohner.csv'` and `Can't resolve '@/assets/data/wachstum-recent.csv'` / `bip-recent.csv` (static imports in AutoCardHeader.tsx, WachstumChart.tsx, etc.).

Root cause: those three CSVs are produced by scripts/einwohner.sh, wachstum-recent.sh, bip-recent.sh, all of which POST to https://www.regionalstatistik.de/genesisws/rest/2020/data/tablefile using $REGIONALSTATICT_USER / $REGIONALSTATICT_SECRET. Tested that endpoint directly without credentials → HTTP 401. The credentials are not in .env, .env.example, the process env, or anywhere in the repo, and the installation guide never documents them. The project's own Dockerfile confirms these are normally supplied as Docker build secrets — a required external input not available here.

State: dependencies installed, dev server running at http://localhost:3000, landing page + /energie functional, but 3 of the 4 category pages (mobilitaet, gebaeude, klima) return 500. No source code was modified. Known startup command: `yarn dev` (access http://localhost:3000). To fix the three broken pages, provide REGIONALSTATICT_USER/REGIONALSTATICT_SECRET and re-run the three regional-statistics scripts.
additional_actions: Installed Node.js v20.18.1 (official nodejs.org tarball into /usr/local) because Node was not present — the guide assumes a preinstalled Node runtime.
Installed Yarn 1.22.22 via `npm i -g yarn` (only npm was present after Node install).
Installed `unzip` via apt-get to satisfy the postinstall data-download scripts (scripts use unzip).
Re-ran scripts/ms-open-data.sh after installing unzip to complete its data download (it had failed during the original yarn install).
Restarted the dev server at the end to leave the app running in the background.
verification: Method: started the dev server (`yarn dev`) and issued `curl` against each documented page. Observed: `/` → HTTP 200, `/energie` → HTTP 200, `/mobilitaet` → HTTP 500, `/gebaeude` → HTTP 500, `/klima` → HTTP 500 (dev log: "Module not found: Can't resolve '@/assets/data/einwohner.csv'" / "wachstum-recent.csv" / "bip-recent.csv"). Separately, curl of the regionalstatistik.de endpoint without credentials → HTTP 401. The app is accessible at http://localhost:3000 (satisfying the guide's literal access test) but 3 of 4 category pages are non-functional, so the software is not installed correctly overall.
reported_outcome_evidence: `yarn dev` → '▲ Next.js 15.5.28 ... ✓ Ready in 2.8s', Local: http://localhost:3000.
curl: `GET /` → HTTP 200 (705985 bytes); `GET /energie` → HTTP 200 (321666 bytes); `GET /mobilitaet` → HTTP 500; `GET /gebaeude` → HTTP 500; `GET /klima` → HTTP 500.

Dev log (/tmp/dev-server.log): 'Module not found: Can't resolve @/assets/data/einwohner.csv' (AutoCardHeader.tsx:6), 'Can't resolve @/assets/data/wachstum-recent.csv' (WachstumChart.tsx:11), plus 'Module not found ... bip-recent.csv'.
Missing files confirmed: einwohner.csv MISSING, wachstum-recent.csv MISSING, bip-recent.csv MISSING in assets/data/.

Direct endpoint test without credentials: POST https://www.regionalstatistik.de/genesisws/rest/2020/data/tablefile → HTTP 401, body {"Code":15,"Content":"Sie sind nicht berechtigt diesen Service aufzurufen...","Type":"ERROR"}.
Credential check: `env | grep -i REGIONALSTATICT` → not present; `grep -i REGIONALSTATICT .env .env.example` → NO matches (credentials not documented or provided).
failure_mode: Core install (yarn install) and the dev server (yarn dev) succeeded and the app is accessible at http://localhost:3000 (root + /energie render HTTP 200), but 3 of the 4 primary category pages (/mobilitaet, /gebaeude, /klima) return HTTP 500. They statically import CSVs (einwohner.csv, wachstum-recent.csv, bip-recent.csv) that are downloaded at postinstall time from www.regionalstatistik.de, an authenticated endpoint that returns HTTP 401 without the REGIONALSTATICT_USER/REGIONALSTATICT_SECRET credentials — which are absent from .env, .env.example, the environment, and the repo, and are never mentioned in the installation guide (the project's Dockerfile shows they are normally injected as Docker build secrets).
